channel.title: Resilient Faith
channel.description: Resilient Faith explores faith, hope, wisdom and spiritual resilience in a rapidly changing world — a 30-day journey of Scripture, reflection and prayer, by Isaac Bright Addo.

item.title: What Remains When Everything Else Changes? | Resilient Faith Day 1
item.description: Discover why faith offers stability in a changing world. Reflect on Hebrews 13:8 and learn how to build confidence in God's unchanging character.

item.title: Building Life on a Solid Foundation | Resilient Faith Day 2
item.description: Explore Jesus' teaching about wise foundations and discover how faith helps people endure life's storms.

item.title: Faith Beyond Feelings: Walking by Faith Not Sight | Resilient Faith Day 3
item.description: Learn how faith grows even when emotions fluctuate and circumstances feel uncertain.

item.title: Trusting God in Uncertain Times | Resilient Faith Day 4
item.description: Discover practical ways to trust God when the future feels uncertain.

item.title: Knowledge vs Wisdom: What's the Difference? | Resilient Faith Day 5
item.description: Explore the biblical distinction between knowledge and wisdom and why both matter.

item.title: When the Future Feels Unknown: Trusting God's Plan | Resilient Faith Day 6
item.description: Discover how to trust God when the future feels uncertain. Learn practical faith principles from Jeremiah 29:11 to navigate life's unknowns.

item.title: Finding God's Peace Amid Anxiety | Resilient Faith Day 7
item.description: Find biblical peace amid anxiety and stress through Philippians 4:6-7. Explore how prayer transforms worry into trust.

item.title: Why Does God Allow Difficult Times? | Resilient Faith Day 8
item.description: Why does God allow suffering and difficult seasons? Explore James 1:2-4 and discover how challenges can strengthen faith.

item.title: Strength Made Perfect in Weakness | Resilient Faith Day 9
item.description: Learn how God's strength is revealed through human weakness. Reflect on 2 Corinthians 12:9 and the power of grace.

item.title: How Prayer Builds Spiritual Resilience | Resilient Faith Day 10
item.description: Discover how prayer builds spiritual resilience, deepens faith, and helps believers navigate life's challenges with hope.

item.title: The Courage to Keep Moving Forward | Resilient Faith Day 11
item.description: Explore biblical courage through Joshua 1:9 and learn how to move forward despite fear and uncertainty.

item.title: Faith During Seasons of Waiting | Resilient Faith Day 12
item.description: Waiting is hard. Learn how Isaiah 40:31 provides hope, patience, and strength during seasons of delay.

item.title: When God Feels Silent | Resilient Faith Day 13
item.description: What should believers do when God seems silent? Discover encouragement from Psalm 13 and honest biblical faith.

item.title: Choosing Faith Over Fear | Resilient Faith Day 14
item.description: Replace fear with faith through practical biblical wisdom from Isaiah 41:10 and God's promises of presence.

item.title: Can Science and Faith Work Together? | Resilient Faith Day 15
item.description: Can science and faith coexist? Explore how faith and scientific discovery can complement each other rather than conflict.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Human Purpose | Resilient Faith Day 16
item.description: Artificial intelligence is transforming society. Discover what Scripture says about human purpose, identity, and meaning.

item.title: Faith in the Information Age | Resilient Faith Day 17
item.description: Navigate information overload with biblical wisdom. Learn how to renew your mind and remain spiritually focused.

item.title: How to Find Truth in a Noisy World | Resilient Faith Day 18
item.description: Find truth in a noisy world by exploring Jesus' claim in John 14:6 and developing spiritual discernment.

item.title: Technology and Spiritual Distraction | Resilient Faith Day 19
item.description: Technology offers convenience but can create distraction. Learn how to cultivate spiritual focus in a digital age.

item.title: Success, Ambition and Eternal Priorities | Resilient Faith Day 20
item.description: Success and ambition have value, but what matters most? Reflect on eternal priorities through Mark 8:36.

item.title: Finding Hope in Troubled Times | Resilient Faith Day 21
item.description: Discover lasting hope amid uncertainty, conflict, and difficulty through Christ's promises in John 16:33.

item.title: The Transformative Power of Gratitude | Resilient Faith Day 22
item.description: Gratitude changes perspective and strengthens faith. Explore practical ways to cultivate thankfulness every day.

item.title: Serving Others with Purpose | Resilient Faith Day 23
item.description: Serving others reflects the heart of Christian faith. Learn how purpose grows through acts of service.

item.title: Why Community Strengthens Faith | Resilient Faith Day 24
item.description: Faith grows stronger in community. Discover the biblical importance of encouragement, fellowship, and support.

item.title: The Freedom of Forgiveness | Resilient Faith Day 25
item.description: Forgiveness brings freedom and healing. Learn how biblical forgiveness transforms relationships and personal well-being.

item.title: Stewardship of Creation: A Biblical Perspective | Resilient Faith Day 26
item.description: Explore a biblical perspective on environmental stewardship and caring for God's creation responsibly.

item.title: Integrity When No One Is Watching | Resilient Faith Day 27
item.description: Integrity matters, especially when nobody is watching. Reflect on Micah 6:8 and the importance of character.

item.title: Being a Light in Everyday Life | Resilient Faith Day 28
item.description: Learn practical ways to be a positive influence and reflect God's light through everyday actions.

item.title: Developing Faith That Endures | Resilient Faith Day 29
item.description: Faith is a lifelong journey. Discover how perseverance and daily trust build enduring spiritual resilience.

item.title: The Eternal Hope of God's Promises | Resilient Faith Day 30
item.description: Explore the Christian hope of restoration, renewal, and eternal life through Revelation 21:1-5.
